entries.fc21d6093ac19dce: In July 2020, the Group formulated its long-term vision, “Higashi Group VISION2030,” and sets out as its aspirational image “a company that continues to transform in order to deliver the best service to its customers.” As the medium-term management strategy toward realizing this, it formulated the “Medium-Term Management Plan 2028” in May 2025, positioning these three years as “three years to complete the fundamentals for promotion to the Prime Market.” Under its group purpose, “Peace of mind forever, surprises more.
